description: Where to connect to a knowledge base: an endpoint, and the labels a client keeps of it. It carries no identity: which knowledge base answers at an address is known only once it has been reached with a token and asked, so a target is what every caller can build before then, and a session's whole input. A client keeps it locally; it is never sent.

id.description: The key the client stores a session's credentials under. Two sessions that share one storage have two ids, or each overwrites the other's tokens. Whoever builds the target chooses it; none is made up.

label.description: What a person reads the knowledge base as. Once the knowledge base has described itself, its own name.
